items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: And I picked up his answer one night

ctx.x: Now, this fella, Johnny Dott, he was a good clanness player too, isn't he? But, he had his credit tied down, all the keys tied down, mostly. And I picked up his answer one night, he used to have, on 3rd Street, you can call that place, something they used to call that place. But anyhow, he used to turn it over, I think, at that time.
What do you mean, tied down, had rubber bands or something?
